# TD Local SEO

> Local SEO agency serving Palm Coast, FL and Flagler County. We help small businesses rank on Google Maps and Google Search — no contracts, no fluff.

## What We Do
- Google Business Profile optimization
- Local citation building (40+ directories)
- On-page SEO and technical SEO audits
- Local keyword research and content strategy
- Review generation and reputation management
- Monthly SEO reporting with real metrics

## Who We Serve
Local service businesses in Palm Coast, Flagler Beach, Bunnell, and Flagler County, FL. Plumbers, HVAC contractors, roofers, landscapers, pest control, dentists, lawyers, restaurants, and any business where customers search on Google Maps.

## Why Local SEO Matters
Most local businesses get 60-80% of their new customers from Google searches. If you're not in the Google Maps 3-pack, you're invisible to most of your market. We fix that.
